title: Hospice Liaison Note: Hospice Elections and Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces Rentals
content:
When a patient elects hospice and the terminal diagnosis requires the bed, the hospice furnishes the Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed from the election date where the class's hospice billing-stop value is Yes: rental months beginning on or after the hospice election date are not billed to coverage, and one billed in error is denied with the reason hospice enrollment and is never charged to the patient. Summit Ridge then either picks the bed up on the family's confirmed return or keeps it in place only under a separate arrangement with the hospice, which this charter does not price. A hospice election is recorded only from the hospice's notice of election, never from the family's statement alone.

The hospice billing-stop value is a published figure of the bed class.

## Points the liaison desk works from

- **Which months stop.** Rental months whose first day is on or after the hospice election date are not billed to coverage. A month whose first day is before the election date is not reached by this rule.
- **A month billed in error.** It is denied with the reason hospice enrollment and is never charged to the patient.
- **The bed after the election.** Summit Ridge either picks it up on the family's confirmed return, or keeps it in place only under a separate arrangement with the hospice. This charter sets no price for such an arrangement.
- **Recording the election.** The hospice election date is recorded on the bed record only from the hospice's notice of election. A family member's statement alone is not enough.

## Month start dates against the election date (hypothetical dates)

| Hypothetical hospice election date | Hypothetical first day of the rental month | Billed to coverage under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| 18 March | 18 March | No — the month begins on the election date |
| 18 March | 2 April | No — the month begins after the election date |
| 18 March | 2 March | Not stopped by this rule — the month begins before the election date |

## Question and answer

**A family member telephones to say the patient has elected hospice. Is the election recorded?** Not on that statement alone; the election is recorded only from the hospice's notice of election.

**A month beginning after the election date was billed and paid by mistake. May the patient be charged for it?** No. Such a month is denied with the reason hospice enrollment and is never charged to the patient.
